প্রশ্ন প্রণয়নে:
জনাব সালেহ আহমেদ
৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English Wizard.question: ১) I saw some birds flying in the sky. (Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I saw some birds who were flying in the sky.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I saw some birds what were flying in the sky.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I saw some birds which were flying in the sky.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I saw some birds and they were flying in the sky.
English Wizard.exp: verb+ing Adjective হিসেবে থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে ব্যক্তি হলে who/that+ tense অনুযায়ী verb আর বস্তু হলে which/ that +Tense অনুযায়ী verb বসে।

English Wizard.question: ২) Belal was only thirteen. (Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Belal was not less thirteen.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Belal was not more than thirteen.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Belal was not less than thirteen.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) None but Belal was thirteen.
English Wizard.exp: only সংখ্যা, বয়স ইত্যাদির পূর্বে ব্যবহৃত হলে এর পরিবর্তে not more than ব্যবহৃত হয়। অনেক বইয়ে not less than ও শুদ্ধ নিয়ম লিখা থাকলেও মূলত এটি ভুল। কারণ only দিয়ে কম অর্থ প্রকাশ করছে। not less than বললে এ ভাবার্থ ঠিক থাকে না।

English Wizard.question: ৩) We should abide by the rules. (Imperative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Abide by the rules.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Should abide by the rules.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let us abide by the rules.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let us abiding by the rules.
English Wizard.exp: Subject You ছাড়া অন্য কিছু হলে Imperative করতে হলে Let+ Objective form of subject + base form of verb বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৪) Computer is a great invention. (Exclamatory)
English Wizard.option1: ক) What an invention computer is!
English Wizard.option2: খ) How invention computer is!
English Wizard.option3: গ) What a invention computer is!
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) What a great invention computer is!
English Wizard.exp: great + noun এর পরিবর্তে what a/an + noun বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৫) You need to spend money. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Money is needed by you to spend.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Money need to be spent by you.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Money needs to be spent by you.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Money is needed to be spent by you.
English Wizard.exp:
ক- প্রদত্ত বাক্যের অর্থ তোমার টাকা ব্যয় করা প্রয়োজন। কিন্তু (ক) এর অর্থ - ব্যয় করার জন্য তোমার টাকা প্রয়োজন।
খ,গ - need এর পর to থাকলে need কে Principal verb বিবেচনা করে Number person অনুযায়ী Verb বসাতে হয়। এ হিসেবে খ ভুল এবং গ সঠিক।
ঘ- একই Clause এ দুটি Passive verb ব্যবহৃত হয় না।

English Wizard.question: ৬) Adam’s fall was a fortunate fall. (Compound)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Adam fell and it was a fortunate fall.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Adam fell but it was a fortunate fall.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Adam falled but it was fortunate fall.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Adam’s fall was fall which was fortunate.
English Wizard.exp: Adam’s fall – Phrase কে Clause এ রূপান্তুরিত করলে প্রসঙ্গ অনুযায়ী Adam fell হবে। আর এর সাথে it was fortunate fall হচ্ছে বিপরীতধর্মী ধারণা, কারণ fall বা পতন সাধারণত দুর্ভাগ্য হিসেবে বিবেচিত হয়। আর বিপরীতধর্মিী ধারণা হলে Compound Sentence এ Conjunction – but ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Wizard.question: ৭) The patient died after the doctor had come.
English Wizard.option1: ক) The patient died after coming the doctor.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The patient died after the doctor arrival.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The patient died after the arrival of the doctor.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The patient died after the doctor coming.
English Wizard.exp:
ক, খ, ঘ তিনটিই Structure অনুযায়ী বাক্য অশুদ্ধ।
গ-তে সমার্থক শব্দ সঠিক Structure এ আসার কারণে গ-ই এখানে শুদ্ধ বাক্য।

English Wizard.question: ৮) As soon as the pirates understood the presence of the navy, they left. (Simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) On understanding the presence of the of the navy, they left.
English Wizard.option2: খ) At understanding the presence of the navy, they left.
English Wizard.option3: গ) In understanding the presence of the navy, the pirates left.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) On understanding the presence of the navy, the pirates left.
English Wizard.exp:
Complex Sentence এ as soon as থাকলে Simple Sentence এ on বসে।
প্রথম অংশে Subject বাদ পড়ায়, ২য় অংশে Subject এর Noun Form বসাতে হবে।

English Wizard.question: ৯) He had a secret desire so that he could marry the princess. (Simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He wanted to marry the princess for his secret desire.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He had a secret desire for marrying the princess.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He had a secret desire with a view to marrying the princess.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He had a secret desire to marry the princess.
English Wizard.exp:
ক- প্রসঙ্গের সাথে মিল নেই।
খ- ভবিষ্যতে কোন কিছু করার উদ্দেশ্য বুঝালে for ব্যবহৃত হয় না।
গ- desire দিয়েই উদ্দেশ্য বুঝায়, তাই with a view to ব্যবহার শুদ্ধ হবে না।
ঘ- so that থাকলে to/ in order to+ verb এর base form বসে। তবে desire, wish ইত্যাদির পর in order to বসানো যাবে না, শুধু to বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১০) Helen was the most beautiful woman in the world. (Positive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Very few women in the world were as beautiful as Helen.
English Wizard.option2: খ) No other woman in the world was as beautiful as Helen.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Helen was more beautiful than any other woman in the world.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) No other womans in the world were as beautiful as Helen.
English Wizard.exp:
Comparative / Superlative কে Positive করতে হলে চারটি কাজ করতে হয়:
1. Subject- Predicate হয়, Predicate - Subject হয়
2. Affirmative -Negative হয়, Negative Affirmative হয়
3. Degree change হয়
4. Indicator (the/ than--> so...as, as...as) Change হয়
Structure: One of the ছাড়া শুধু Superlative Degree থাকলে :- No other+ Predicate অংশের Noun+ Verb+ as/ so + Positive Degree+ as + Subject
নিয়ম/ Structure অনুযায়ী খ সঠিক।

English Wizard.question: ১১) No other student in the class was as studious as Polash. (Comparative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Polash is the most studious student in the class.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Polash is more studious than any other students in the class.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Polash is more studious than many other students in the class.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Polash is more studious than all other students in the class.
English Wizard.exp: No other থাকলে Comparative করতে হলে than any other+ Singular Noun অথবা than all other+ Plural Noun বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১২) Very few women were as ill-fated as Maurya. (Superlative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Maurya is one of the most ill-fated women.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Maurya was the most ill-fated women.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Maurya was one of the most ill-fated woman.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Maurya was one of the most ill-fated women.
English Wizard.exp:
Very few থাকলে- Superlative করার সময়-
1. Subject- predicate এবং Predicate – Subject হয়।
2. one of the +Superlative degree + Plural noun বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) Even this good news could not satisfy him. (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He was not satisfied even with this good news.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He was not satisfied even at this good news.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He was not satisfied even by this good news.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He was not satisfied even for this good news.
English Wizard.exp: Passive Voice এ satisfied এর পর ব্যক্তি/ বস্তু সবকিছুর পূর্বেইwith বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) What made him cry? (Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) By what he was made to cry?
English Wizard.option2: খ) By what he was made cry?
English Wizard.option3: গ) By what was he made to cry?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) By what he was made to be cried?
English Wizard.exp:
Active Voice এ What Subject হলে Passive voice এ by what বসে।
Wh Words (who, what ইত্যাদি) ছাড়া অন্য কিছু Subject হলে Interrogative Sentence এ Auxiliary Verb – Subject এর পূর্বে বসে।
Make এর পর Bare Infinitive (উহ্য to) Active Voice এ হলেও, Passive Voice এ to যোগ করতে হয়। আর একই Clause এর মধ্যে দুইবার Passive হয় না। এ হিসেবে কেবল গ সঠিক।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) Which word is wrongly spelt?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Dehydration
English Wizard.option2: খ) Typhoid
English Wizard.option3: গ) Diarroea
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Dysentery
English Wizard.exp: Correct Spelling : Diarrhoea

English Wizard.question: ১৬) Which word has no spelling error?
English Wizard.option1: ক) Renaissance
English Wizard.option2: খ) Reminiscance
English Wizard.option3: গ) Tigeress
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Renounciation
English Wizard.exp:
Correct Spelling :
Renaissance = নবজাগরণ
Reminiscence = স্মৃতিচারণ
Tigress = বাঘিনী
Renunciation = ত্যাগ, পরিত্যাগ

English Wizard.question: ১৭) Which spelling is correct?
English Wizard.option1: ক) comission
English Wizard.option2: খ) commission
English Wizard.option3: গ) commision
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) comision
English Wizard.exp: No explanation added.

English Wizard.question: ১৮) What is the noun form of fly?
English Wizard.option1: ক) fly
English Wizard.option2: খ) flying
English Wizard.option3: গ) flight
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) flow
English Wizard.exp:
fly (verb)= উড়া,
flight (noun) = উড্ডয়ন

English Wizard.question: ১৯) What is the adverb form of hard?
English Wizard.option1: ক) hardly
English Wizard.option2: খ) hard
English Wizard.option3: গ) hardful
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) hardily
English Wizard.exp:
hard এর Adverb form ও hard.
hard (adj)= কঠিন, কঠোর যেমন- It is a hard task.
hard (adv) = কঠিনভাবে, কঠোরভাবে যেমন- He works hard.
hardly (অন্য Adverb) = কদাচিৎ, না বললেই চলে যেমন- He hardly comes here.

English Wizard.question: ২০) The adjective form of grammar is –
English Wizard.option1: ক) grammarian
English Wizard.option2: খ) grammatical
English Wizard.option3: গ) grammartical
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) grammatic
English Wizard.exp: grammar এর adjective গঠনের সময় এর r বাদ পড়ে Grammatical হয়।

English Wizard.question: ২১) The theme of a paragraph is delineated in its-
English Wizard.option1: ক) first sentence
English Wizard.option2: খ) body
English Wizard.option3: গ) topic sentence
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) terminator
English Wizard.exp: delineate মানে বিশদভাবে বর্ণনা করা। বিশদভাবে theme এর বর্ণনা Paragraph এর body এর মধ্যে করা হয়।

English Wizard.question: ২২) The number of theme/themes in a letter is-
English Wizard.option1: ক) one
English Wizard.option2: খ) three
English Wizard.option3: গ) more than one
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) indefinite
English Wizard.exp: Letter এর মধ্যে theme সংখ্যা নির্দিষ্ট নয়, তাই সঠিক উত্তর indefinite বা অনির্দিষ্ট।

English Wizard.question: ২৩) Every rose has a thorn. (Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There is no rose but a thorn.
English Wizard.option2: খ) There is no rose without a thorn.
English Wizard.option3: গ) There is no rose but have a thorn.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) No rose but has a thorn.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যটির সঠিক Negative ২টি হতে পারে
There is no rose but has a thorn.
There is no rose without a thorn.

English Wizard.question: ২৪) All must die. (Interrogative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Who must not die?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Who will not die?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Is there anyone but will not die?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Who must die?
English Wizard.exp:
Assertive এ All থাকলে Interrogative করতে হলে who + negative verb বসে।
must এর পরিবর্তে এখানে অর্থসঙ্গতি রক্ষার জন্য will বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ২৫) Tomy said to me, “What do you know about the issue?”
English Wizard.option1: ক) Tomy asked me what did I know about the issue?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Tomy said to me what I know about the issue.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Tomy asked me what I did knew about the issue?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Tomy asked me what I knew about the issue.
English Wizard.exp: Indirect Narration এ সব ধরনের বাক্যকে Assertive এ পরিণত করতে হয়। Auxiliary Verb- Subject এর পরে বসবে। নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb- do বাদ যাবে। Reporting Verb -said Past Tense হওয়ায় মূল Verb-know এর Past form – knew হবে।
